name: Kali Temple
town_description: Kokrajhar is the headquarters town of Kokrajhar district in the Bodoland Territorial Region of western Assam, on NH 27 west of Guwahati; it is known for the Mahamaya Dham Shakti peeth at nearby Bogribari, Chakrashila Wildlife Sanctuary, and a noted tradition of communal harmony.
